# UI/Widgets

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [ComboBox.h](ComboBox.h): A box showing one item out of a list, and the list itself while it is open. (declares `ComboBox`)
- [ListBox.h](ListBox.h): Where a ListBox gets its rows. (declares `ListBoxModel`, `ListBox`)
- [MenuBarComponent.h](MenuBarComponent.h): A row of menu titles, each opening its menu as a PopupMenu: a menu bar drawn in the tree. (declares `MenuBarComponent`)
- [PopupMenu.h](PopupMenu.h): What a menu is drawn with. (declares `PopupMenuStyle`, `PopupMenuPlacement`, `PopupMenuOptions`, `PopupMenu`)
- [Tabs.h](Tabs.h): A row of tabs, exactly one of them selected. (declares `TabBar`, `TabbedComponent`)
- [Theme.h](Theme.h): declares `ThemeValue`, `themeKeyId`, `ThemeKey`, `ColourKey`, `NumberKey`, `FontKey`, `defaultTheme`, `Theme`
- [ThemeKeys.h](ThemeKeys.h): umbrella header: includes 1 headers
- [TouchScroller.h](TouchScroller.h): Whether a finger that went down at `from` and is now at `to` is still a tap. (declares `isWithinTouchSlop`, `isTouchTap`, `ScrollAxes`, `TouchScroller`, `TouchScrolling`)
- [Viewport.h](Viewport.h): How a Viewport draws its scrollbars. (declares `ScrollbarStyle`, `Viewport`)
- [Widgets.h](Widgets.h): Every widget below draws in its host's theme (Component::getHostTheme) under the keys in ThemeKeys.h, and a colour given to the widget itself, by setColour or setAccentColour, wins over the theme's. (declares `Label`, `Button`, `Checkbox`, `TextEditor`, `Slider`, `Knob`, `ScrollPanel`)
